title: Endless Rails: Train Driver
short: Drive endless trains through a living world. Learn real braking. Free to play.
full:
ENDLESS RAILS is a calm, realistic train-driving game set on an endless double-track main line that is generated ahead of you as you drive — forests, mountains, rivers, cities, villages and coastlines, day and night, in every weather.

DRIVE FOR REAL
• Throttle and brake levers, brake-pipe pressure, emergency braking, reverse, horn, lights and wipers
• Signals, speed limits, curves, gradients, junctions you can set, and an ATP that warns or brakes for you
• Two trains: the “Classic” regional train (160 km/h) and the Shinkansen-inspired “Strela HS” high-speed train (250 km/h) with a long aerodynamic nose
• Train length matters: every extra car adds mass, so you accelerate slower and need longer to stop

LEARN TO DRIVE — DRIVER TRAINING
Six lessons take you from the first lever to stopping within one metre of the mark: controls, acceleration and stopping distances, approaching a station at 120 km/h, precise stops with grades (perfect / excellent / good / poor / missed), braking from 40 to 250 km/h, and real situations — long and short approaches, heavy trains, wet rails and gradients. Every number comes from the game's own physics.

MODES
• Free ride — no tasks, no penalties, just the journey
• Schedule — stations 10–100 km apart, a realistic timetable and a graded stop at every station
• Plus optional extras: scenic journey, cab ride, photo mode, the precise-stop challenge and an event sandbox

A LIVING WORLD
Other trains on the line, road traffic at level crossings, busy stations with departure boards and announcements, planes overhead — and rare moments: rainbows, auroras, meteor showers, rocket launches, a volcano waking up in the distance.

FAIR AND FREE
The whole core game is free and has no banner ads and no ads while you drive. If you like, you can unlock extra content (the high-speed train, longer trains, liveries and extra modes) by choosing to watch a short rewarded video in the Extras section. Unlocks are permanent.

10 languages: English, Русский, Українська, 简体中文, Română, Português (Brasil), Español, Français, Deutsch, 日本語.
Four graphics levels (Low to Ultra) with automatic detection — runs on modest phones and looks great on powerful ones. Works offline (ads need a connection).
